item.tib: rtsa gsum bde gshegs 'dus pa'i rgyud las drag blug bskal pa'i thog rgod 'bar ba'i phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa 'di nyid snying grogs dge rgen (rgan) sa trig sam sad kyis bon skal du phog nas ring po'i dus nas bskul ba la brten nas/ snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon po 'chi med nam mkha' sgron gsal rol gar mngon par bstan pa'i/ tshe dbang bde chen snying po'i dbyings kyi gsang dral (gral) 'dzin cing tshogs la rol ba'i skabs su g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag la/ deng sang snyigs ma lnga brdol gyi dus su 'gro la rnam par brtse bas zhal gyis bzhes pa'i rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen dngos su mi gzugs su sprul nas zhal lung gnang bzhin lcags bya zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes la shar grol smin gling du sug bris bgyis pas dge bar gyur cig/
